notes.title: DEMO Update Announcement
notes.notes:
To Followers



Thank you for your continued support!



To enhance gameplay and streamline storylines, the game demo has undergone a new round of updates this year.



This update introduces several auxiliary plugins, which will inevitably cause corruption of older save files (created before September 2025).



Due to limited technical resources, this issue cannot be resolved at present, potentially requiring you to restart your playthrough.





Update List:



· Combat system modifications

· Partial storyline alterations

· Changes to certain book content

· Menu interface optimization

· Backpack item indicator icon improvements

 From 诚夏
